title: Ewald periodic potentials and particle mesh error

items.title: Causal cardinal spline window
items.strategy: Define the causal order-P cardinal window by its finite truncated-power formula so periodic assignment is pointwise and finite.

items.title: Neutral point sources and Fourier data on a three-dimensional torus
items.strategy: Fix the physical and reciprocal lattices, torus coordinates, Fourier convention, and neutral finite source data.

items.title: Gaussian screened Coulomb kernel and its self limit
items.strategy: Differentiate the radial error-function potential, verify its distributional source by the flux at the origin, and compute the finite self part.

items.title: Periodic cardinal-spline assignment and unitary mesh transform
items.strategy: Define the causal order-P periodic window, residue accumulation, signed retained modes, denominator guard, and exact output convention.

items.title: Poisson periodization of a normalized Gaussian on a full-rank lattice
items.strategy: Apply the published Schwartz lattice Poisson theorem only to the normalized Gaussian and convert its ordinary dual frequency to angular physical frequency.

items.title: Uniform lattice-shell counts and explicit Gaussian tail controllers
items.strategy: Use disjoint balls around lattice points for a uniform shell count and an integral-test controller for every Gaussian-polynomial tail used later.

items.title: Smooth torus test functions have rapidly convergent Fourier pairings
items.strategy: Repeated periodic integration by parts gives coefficient decay; lattice counting and the uniform derivative theorem give convergence in every smooth seminorm.

items.title: Exact three-dimensional spline assignment aliases and FFT normalization
items.strategy: Prove the partition and Fourier multiplier of the causal cardinal window, derive every signed alias, and bound the source-alias series by explicit p-series remainders.

items.title: The mean-zero Fourier distribution solves the neutral periodic Poisson equation
items.strategy: Define the distribution by its polynomially bounded Fourier coefficients, test against all smooth periodic functions, and prove uniqueness after fixing the zero mode.

items.title: Derivative-window alias bounds including the P=2 knot branch
items.strategy: For P>=3 sum the differentiated signed aliases with a p-series tail; for P=2 use the finite piecewise derivative-window formula and explicit knot values.

items.title: The alpha-independent Ewald potential and renormalized energy
items.strategy: Show the short and Gaussian-smoothed distributions sum to the unique neutral mean-zero solution, then take the regular part at each source.

items.title: Deterministic reciprocal particle-mesh Ewald potential, energy, and force bounds
items.strategy: Compare finite mesh and exact retained reciprocal energies and their declared forces by a product identity, separating source aliases, derivative aliases, gather error, and self correction.

items.title: Explicit real and reciprocal Ewald potential, energy, and force tail bounds
items.strategy: Bound omitted image and reciprocal shells separately for energy and differentiated force, retaining cell-shape constants and collision conventions.

items.title: Total deterministic Ewald and particle-mesh error certificate
items.strategy: Add exact cutoff tails, finite mesh alias and differentiation bounds, and supplied outward arithmetic radii; return inconclusive whenever a required radius or denominator guard is unavailable.

items.title: Certified three-dimensional particle-mesh Ewald evaluator
items.strategy: Specify the charge spread, tensor FFT, safe deconvolution, reciprocal solve, gather, optional diagonal self correction, certified error ledger, and every failure status.

title: Ewald periodic potentials and particle mesh error — Examples

items.title: A nonneutral periodic source has no periodic Poisson solution
items.strategy: Test the weak equation against the constant function to isolate the necessary zero-mode compatibility condition.

items.title: A neutral dipole cell and its reciprocal modes
items.strategy: Compute the signed structure factor of a two-charge neutral cell and state its zero mode and reciprocal selection.

items.title: A point-source potential is singular at a source
items.strategy: Isolate the local 1/r and 1/r^2 singular terms and bound every remaining periodic contribution near a source.

items.title: Opposite real and reciprocal cutoff trends in the Ewald parameter
items.strategy: Read the opposite monotonic dependence on alpha from the two explicit Gaussian tail controllers at fixed cutoffs.

items.title: The energy-gradient mesh force matches the differentiated mesh energy
items.strategy: Differentiate the finite mesh energy, exhibit the position-dependent diagonal term, and distinguish the P=2 knot branch from a classical gradient.
